Leah: heads-up  new hospital prospect needs exportable forensics + BYOK mapping before pilot. need clear MVP and contract language.
Ibrahim: for MVP we can build a "forensics bundle": logs + manifests + signed checksums. estimate 2 sprints.
Noor: security asks: signed manifest, requester audit trail, and key_id reference in manifest. no HSM attestation in MVP.
Sam: customer will accept MVP if we provide an explicit gap doc + buyout path to HSM later. they want pricing by Wed.
Contracts: we can draft an MOA that lists delivered artifacts and excludes HSM attestation; add upgrade addendum for HSM.
Ibrahim: quick API sketch for docs: POST /v1/exports {tenant_id, range, format:"forensics-bundle"} -> export_id. GET returns download_url + signed_manifest.
InfraBot: note: export performance depends on cold storage throughput. multipart streaming recommended.
Leah: acceptance criteria for pilot: - bundle contains signed_manifest + control_index - export <6h for <=50GB or partial incremental available - audit trail retained >=2y - runbook + release notes.
Noor: tests: manifest verification, RBAC enforcement, legal-hold blocks export. QA owner: Eng QA.
Sam: I'll confirm customer acceptance and which KMS vendors they insist on (if any).
Leah: action items: Ibrahim -> spec PR (due Mon); Noor -> gap/risk memo (due Tue); Contracts -> MOA draft (Tue); Sam -> customer confirm (Fri). reconvene after confirmations. :thumbsup:
